title: Suresh Malhotra v. Dinesh Ahuja
text: The landlord, Suresh Malhotra, initiated eviction proceedings against the tenant, Dinesh Ahuja, under the Delhi Rent Control Act on grounds of non-payment of rent and misuse of premises. The tenancy was for commercial purpose but the tenant converted part of the premises to residential use. Under the Delhi Rent Control Act, misuse of tenancy premises is a ground for eviction. The tenant argued he was a protected tenant due to long possession exceeding 10 years. The court examined the lease deed and rental receipts. The premises were clearly demised for commercial purposes. The conversion to residential use constitutes breach of the tenancy agreement and a ground under the Rent Control Act. Eviction is decreed on the ground of misuse. Additionally, arrears of rent for 15 months remain unpaid despite repeated demands. The landlord is entitled to immediate possession. The tenant's claim of protected tenant status is rejected.
